paite: Babulon tanu nungak siangthou aw, hong suk inla, leivui ah tu in; Kaldai tanu aw, laltutphah tel lou in lei lak ah tu in; awm nou leh nuamsa hon chi nawn lou ding uhi.
heading: Babulon Tung A Thukhenna
english: “Come down, and sit in the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, daughter of the Chaldeans: for you shall no more be called tender and delicate.

paite: Buh gawizanna suangte la inla, tangbuang bawl in; na kikhuhna puan koih inla, na tentual lem inla, na khe hong inla, luite ngap galkah in.
english: Take the millstones, and grind meal; remove your veil, strip off the train, uncover the leg, pass through the rivers.

paite: Na vuaktanna khuh louh in a-om ding a, ahi, na zahmoh adawk ding; phu ka la ding a, mi kuamah ka kithuahpih kei ding.
english: Your nakedness shall be uncovered, yes, your shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and will spare no man.”

paite: Ahon tanpa, amin Sepaihte' TOUPA ahi, Israelte Mi Siangthou.
english: Our Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies is his name, the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Kaldai tanu aw, dai dide in tu inla, mial nuai ah lut in, Gam chih lalnu hon chita kei ding uh TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans; for you shall no more be called the mistress of kingdoms.

paite: Ka mite tung ah ka heh a, ka goutan ka hihthanghuai a, na khut ah ka hon pia hi; nang atung uah zahngaihna na langsak kei a; tek lamte tung ah nangawn ah na hakkol giktak na nga ahi.
english: I was angry with my people, I profaned my inheritance, and gave them into your hand: you showed them no mercy; on the aged you have very heavily laid your yoke.

paite: Kei tangtawn in lalnu ding in ka om ding, na chi a; huchi in huai thilte na lungsim in na ngaihtuah kei a, atawpna ding na theigige sam kei hi.
english: You said, ‘I shall be a mistress forever;’ so that you did not lay these things to your heart, nor did you remember the latter end of it.

paite: Huchi in nang nuamtat a om, awlmoh nei lou a om, lungsim a, "Keimah ka hi, keimah lou midang a-om kei, meithai in ka tu kei ding a, tate tan thu ka thei sam kei ding," chinu, hiai thei in;
english: “Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, ‘I am, and there is none else besides me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:’

paite: Hiai thil nih, tate tanna leh meithaina in, ni khat thu in mitphiat kal lou in ahon pha ding a; na bumna zatna tamngial in, na kivenna tamkuam mahleh, huaite nakpitak in na tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
english: but these two things shall come to you in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood; in their full measure shall they come on you, in the multitude of your sorceries, and the great abundance of your enchantments.

paite: Na gitlouhna muang a; "Kuamah in hon mu kei uh," na chi vial ngal a; na pilna leh na theihna in hon hihsia hi; na lungsim in, "Keimah ka hi, kei lou midang a-om kei," na chi behlap hi.
english: For you have trusted in your wickedness; you have said, No one sees me; your wisdom and your knowledge, it has perverted you, and you have said in your heart, I am, and there is none else besides me.

paite: Huaiziak in thil hoih lou na tung ah ahong tung ding a; na vengsiam kei ding; vangtahna in ahon buak ding a; huai na hihmang thei kei ding; siatna leng thakhat in na tung ah hong tung guih ding a; huai na theikhol kei ding.
english: Therefore evil will come on you; you won’t know when it dawns: and mischief will fall on you; you will not be able to put it away: and desolation shall come on you suddenly, which you don’t know.

paite: Na kikauna leh bumna na zatna, valnou na hih a kipan a na kisukgimnate, dinpih inla; na phattuampih theih ding phot a, na zohpih theih ding photleh.
english: “Stand now with your enchantments, and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth; if so be you shall be able to profit, if so be you may prevail.

paite: Na lemtheihna atam mahmah ziak in na gimta hi; tu in van thu theite, aksi en mite, kha teng a thugenkhol mite ding uhenla, na tung a thil hong tung dingte lak a kipan in hon hong uhen.
english: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels: let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save you from the things that shall come on you.

paite: Ngai in, buhpawl bang lel ahi ding ua; mei in akang ding; meikuang thilhihtheihna lak a kipan akihumbit kei ding uh; hihlumna ding meihol bang ahi kei ding a, awi ding mei bang ahi sam kei ding.
english: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: it shall not be a coal to warm at, nor a fire to sit before.

paite: Huchibang in na kihihgim nakna thilte nang a ding in a-om ding uhi; na naupan nou a kipan a na lak a sumsin mite amau lampi chiat ah avakmang ding ua; hon humbit ding kuamah himhim a-om kei ding uh.
english: Thus shall the things be to you in which you have labored: those who have trafficked with you from your youth shall wander everyone to his quarter; there shall be none to save you.
